[/size][/color]The mod will automatically detect what recolour mod you have installed and recolour the bushes appropriately. You can manually change recolours and styles in the config options in game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config[/url]﻿.
You can also do it manually in the config.json inside of the mod folder if you're a psychopath. See the Readme.txt inside the mod folder if you choose to go that route.

All recolours except for [color=#ffe599][b]Foliage Redone[/b][/color], [b][color=#d5a6bd]Flower Valley[/color][/b], and[b][color=#a2c4c9] Bog's Witchy Foliage[/color][/b] are available in both original Vanilla style and Simple Foliage mod style.

All of the bushes except for a couple of the tropical ones are seasonal and will automatically change with the seasons.
You can also optionally change a select few to other colour options (example: [color=#b6d7a8]green[/color] > [color=#dd7e6b]red[/color] Fall bushes) with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ if the retexture is available.

I highly recommend using the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ to easily determine which bushes have these options available while decorating.
If you do not use Happy Home Designer then you will need the Paint Bucket tool [img]https://i.imgur.com/Zr12HRP.png[/img]﻿ from Robin to change the texture of the bushes while placing them. You will still need the bucket to adjust the textures manually later for already placed bushes.

The custom catalogues can be purchased from Robin for $20,000.
